text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, Trai-chan. Take a look at this.
choice_data_list: An Umatter account?

text_block_list.text:
The account name is "Rumor Scope."
The profile says,
"Investigating the rumors you're curious about."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That's the thing I made.
It's a hobby account that doubles for gathering info, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And guess what?
I just got some juicy info.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, there's a secret training facility
where they gather Umamusume with psychic powers."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Plus, there's intel saying that facility
might be hidden in the mountains nearby.
choice_data_list: Hmm, is that really true...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
They say where there's smoke, there's fire, right?
Hey, why don't we look into it a bit?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan, watch your step.
The path gets pretty narrow around here.
choice_data_list: If you slip there, you'd be done for...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
There's no other way forward, after all.
Summon your courage and let's go♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a piece of junk.
In movies, the cable always snaps halfway through on these.
choice_data_list: Huh? We're crossing this bridge?
Huh? Are we crossing this bridge?

text_block_list.text: (Creak, creak, creak...!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's shaking, it's shaking...!
choice_data_list: (H-how can you be so calm...)

text_block_list.text:
Transcend pushes forward boldly, even through treacherous spots.
Following after her...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...! Trainy, look, over there!

According to the map, this should be an empty lot.
Yet, right in front of me... a building exists.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Nice...! It's really starting to feel real now.
choice_data_list: (Gulp...!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
As far as I can tell, there doesn't seem to be anyone around...
Let's get a closer look for now.
(Bzzzzz!)
choice_data_list: ? I wonder what that sound is...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ――! Trai-chan, look at that...!

Looking over, a swarm of bees was hovering a short distance away...!
They were glaring right at us!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Is she... being wary of me?
choice_data_list: Let's back away slowly so we don't provoke it...!

text_block_list.text:
I somehow managed to reach a spot where the buzzing couldn't be heard.
I wasn't sure what kind of bees they were, but they seemed aggressive and might be venomous.
choice_data_list: Anyway, with that in the way, there's no getting close...
Anyway, with that in the way, there's no getting close, huh...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ah! You brought wireless speakers, right? If we use those...!
choice_data_list: What are you intending to do?
What are you intending to do?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I found this earlier~. "Music that somehow repels bugs." If we just play that through the speaker, you know?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Right?! It's worth a shot.
Besides, I'll take a route that minimizes contact as much as possible.
choice_data_list: No, no, it's still dangerous...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Still, it's not like this plan has zero chance of working, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Once you know the truth,
there might be a real thrill waiting for you, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Then I think I wanna keep moving forward~
choice_data_list: Even so, I can't let you go anywhere dangerous.
...I'm worried, so I'll go with you.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, you meanie.
Boo, boo~.
choice_data_list: Even so, I'm still worried about you, Tran.
Even so, I'm worried about you, Tran.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Mmmph...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Well, if you're putting it that way, can't help it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
In that case...
Can we stop by the Hachimi stand on the way back?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let's soothe our hiking fatigue with something sweet.
Rich. Solid. With chocolate toppings.
choice_data_list: Ah, sure.
Yeah, sure.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Yay~♪ Let's make that our strategy meeting for dealing with bees, then!
Transcend had learned absolutely nothing from the experience...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Trainy.
That's what I'm talking about♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, the bees aren't coming over.
Go, go while we still can."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aaah. To think it was just an ordinary ruin.
No wonder it wasn't on the map~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, we still have plenty of tips coming in.
Let's see what the next scoop brings—

choice_data_list: Whoa, the speaker!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ah. Looks like radio interference. Must've picked it up from somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Wait a minute? In the middle of the mountains with no utility poles?
Where on earth is this coming from...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Could those ruins be a bluff?
Maybe the real entrance is somewhere else entirely?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: This is why I can never quit investigating tips!
